parameters.jsCode: const p=$json; const v=[]; if(p.runId!=='GROWTH-ACQ-012'||p.gate!=='G4')v.push('identity'); if(p.workflowId!=='WF-GROWTH-ACQ-012-G4-001'||p.workflowVersion!=='1.0.0')v.push('workflow'); const c=p.control||{}; if(!c.manualOnly||c.scheduleEnabled||c.webhookEnabled)v.push('trigger'); if(c.maxExternalActions!==0||c.maxCrmWrites!==0||c.spendingAuthorityCents!==0||c.maxAiCalls!==0||c.retryOnUnknownOutcome)v.push('authority'); if((p.requestedActions||[]).length)v.push('requested actions'); const raw=JSON.stringify(p); if(/(?:password|api key|access token|secret)\s*[:=]\s*\S+/i.test(raw)||/(?:\d[ -]*?){13,19}/.test(raw))v.push('sensitive data'); return [{json:{...p,guardStatus:v.length?'Rejected':'Accepted',violations:v}}];

const p=$json; if(p.guardStatus!=='Accepted')return [{json:{runId:p.runId,gate:p.gate,status:'Review',guardStatus:p.guardStatus,violations:p.violations,queue:[],externalActionsPerformed:0,crmWritesPerformed:0,spendingCents:0,aiCalls:0}}]; const weights={buyerFit:25,painEvidence:20,buyingIntent:20,dealValue:15,accessibility:10,urgency:10}; const allowed=new Set(['x','linkedin','upwork','contra','reddit','youtube']); const seen=new Set(); const queue=[]; for(const x of p.items||[]){if(!allowed.has(String(x.channel||'').toLowerCase()))continue; const key=[x.channel,x.id,x.sourceUrl].join('|'); if(seen.has(key))continue; seen.add(key); let score=0; let bad=false; for(const [k,w] of Object.entries(weights)){const n=x.leadDimensions?.[k]; if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<0||n>5){bad=true;break;} score+=(n/5)*w;} if(bad)continue; score=Math.round(score); const route=score>=80?'HOT_REVIEW':score>=60?'WARM_QUEUE':score>=40?'NURTURE':'IGNORE'; queue.push({opportunityId:x.id,channel:x.channel,sourceUrl:x.sourceUrl,observedAt:x.observedAt,score,route,recommendedAction:x.recommendedAction||'draft_response',externalExecution:'BLOCKED_PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL',idempotencyKey:key});} queue.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score); return [{json:{runId:p.runId,gate:p.gate,workflowId:p.workflowId,traceId:p.traceId,status:'Pass',guardStatus:p.guardStatus,queue,summary:{candidateCount:queue.length,hotCount:queue.filter(x=>x.route==='HOT_REVIEW').length,warmCount:queue.filter(x=>x.route==='WARM_QUEUE').length},externalActionsPerformed:0,crmWritesPerformed:0,spendingCents:0,aiCalls:0}}];
